note: Provisional Kit #3J live-track diagnosis. Counts are identified requirements, not court-certified obligations. Subject to SFL-SOURCE-REVIEW-002.

procedural_stages.label: Requesting a JCC
procedural_stages.description: Preparing or filing an initiating request for a Judicial Case Conference.

procedural_stages.label: JCC scheduled
procedural_stages.description: Court has issued a Notice of Judicial Case Conference.

procedural_stages.label: Preparing Appearance Memo
procedural_stages.description: Completing FAM-PD #7-5 and supporting package materials for the scheduled conference.

procedural_stages.label: Serving conference materials
procedural_stages.description: Serving the Appearance Memo package and recording service proof.

procedural_stages.label: Ready for conference
procedural_stages.description: Package reviewed, served, and ready for the scheduled JCC.

documents.title: Judicial Case Conference Appearance Memo
documents.reason_required: Required for a scheduled Judicial Case Conference under Kit #3J Appearance Memo live track.
documents.who_for: Party preparing for the scheduled JCC
documents.when_needed: Before the Appearance Memo filing/service deadline on the Notice
documents.no_longer_required_when: Court directions change the Appearance Memo obligation, or the conference is cancelled/adjourned without requiring this memo.

documents.title: Draft Order
documents.reason_required: Paired draft order for interim relief discussed at or prepared for the JCC package.
documents.when_needed: After relief selections are clear; before package review

governing_source.citation: Kit #3J Form 10-3 draft-order catalog in snapshot jcc-kit-3j-2026-03-30

documents.no_longer_required_when: No interim relief is sought, or court directions remove the draft-order requirement.

documents.title: Request for a Judicial Case Conference
documents.reason_required: Included in Kit #3J for requesting a JCC. If a conference is already scheduled by Notice, confirm whether this request remains applicable.
documents.when_needed: Only if an initiating or renewed request is still required

governing_source.citation: Kit #3J FAM-PD #7-2 catalog in snapshot jcc-kit-3j-2026-03-30

documents.no_longer_required_when: A court Notice already schedules the JCC and no renewed request is required.

documents.title: Child Support Order variant
documents.reason_required: Use only if child-support order wording is confirmed needed.
documents.when_needed: Only after support relief is confirmed
documents.no_longer_required_when: Child-support order wording is not sought.

documents.title: Affidavit of Personal Service
documents.reason_required: Service proof when personally serving package materials.
documents.no_longer_required_when: A different authorized service/proof path is used and accepted.

documents.title: Acknowledgment of Service
documents.reason_required: Service companion when acknowledgment of service is the applicable proof path.
documents.when_needed: When acknowledgment of service is used
documents.no_longer_required_when: Acknowledgment of service is not the chosen proof path.

documents.title: Notice of Judicial Case Conference
documents.reason_required: Court-issued Notice establishes the scheduled conference and Appearance Memo timing.
documents.who_for: Court issues; party archives and confirms
documents.when_needed: When the court schedules the JCC

governing_source.citation: Companion form FAM-PD #7-4 referenced by Kit #3J; exact binary not in current snapshot

documents.no_longer_required_when: Conference cancelled without a Notice obligation.

documents.title: Financial Statement
documents.reason_required: May be required for support-related relief. Official blank is a companion-form gap in the current snapshot.
documents.when_needed: When financial disclosure is required for the relief sought

governing_source.citation: Companion Form 15-47 referenced; not captured in snapshot jcc-kit-3j-2026-03-30

documents.no_longer_required_when: Support/financial disclosure is confirmed not required for this stage.
